clue.text: Provide inspiration for puzzle

parts.note: to provide inspiration is to be a source of it, so this word gives the verb be
a Muse is a goddess of inspiration in Greek myth, so the source of inspiration is a muse

explanation.surface: Someone wants to give a crossword setter the spark for a new puzzle.
explanation.walkthrough: To 'be a muse' is to provide inspiration; the A is passed over in the reading.
explanation.definitionFit: To puzzle someone is to confuse or perplex them, which is what bemusing them does.

clue.text: The finest — and worst

definitions.meaning: used as a verb, to worst is to defeat

explanation.definitionFit: As an adjective it means top-quality; as a verb it means to defeat, the same as to worst.

clue.text: Arrange a star part in a Western

definitions.text: a star part in a Western
definitions.meaning: the lawman with a star badge is a leading role in cowboy films

explanation.definitionFit: Verb sense: to organise in order; noun sense: the badge-wearing US lawman of cowboy films.

clue.text: They are important to one's standing as a rider

definitions.text: They are important to one's standing as a rider

parts.words: They are important to one's standing as a rider
parts.note: standing seems to mean reputation, but a horse rider literally stands up in these

explanation.surface: Things that matter to a jockey's reputation.
explanation.definitionFit: Stirrups are the foot supports a rider stands in on horseback.

clue.text: Stopped talking and prepared to turn the wheel

definitions.meaning: slang for falling silent, as in a curt order to shut up
a driver fastens the seat belt before setting off

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are idioms: slang for shutting up, and literally fastening a seat belt before driving.

clue.text: Footwear sellers paid for repair

indicators.note: the letters need mending into a new order, so the two words are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Shop staff were paid to mend shoes.
explanation.definitionFit: Espadrilles are canvas shoes with rope soles, a kind of footwear.

clue.text: The initial mistake causes panic

indicators.note: the opening letter of the word before it is taken

parts.note: an error is a mistake

explanation.surface: Making the first mistake makes someone panic.
explanation.definitionFit: Terror is extreme fear, which is close in meaning to panic.

clue.text: He'd stir abroad, but remains indecisive

indicators.note: abroad means scattered widely, so the letters before it are rearranged

explanation.surface: A man would cause trouble overseas but cannot make up his mind.
explanation.walkthrough: 'abroad' rearranges HEDSTIR, the letters of He'd stir.
explanation.definitionFit: To dither is to hesitate and fail to decide.

clue.text: Rendered incapable through drink

definitions.meaning: in building, to render a wall is to coat it in plaster

explanation.definitionFit: Building sense: coated with plaster or render; slang sense: heavily drunk.

clue.text: Family stress

definitions.meaning: a line of descent or breed

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a lineage or breed and a load of tension, two unrelated senses.

clue.text: Show how to repeat changes

indicators.note: the letters are changed about, so the two words before it are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A coach demonstrates the right way to do something again.
explanation.walkthrough: 'changes' rearranges the letters of TO and REPEAT; 'how' is a link word and 'Show' is a noun, a stage production.
explanation.definitionFit: An operetta is a light comic opera, a kind of stage show.

clue.text: Robin's nest

parts.note: reads as a garden bird's home but means the hideout of the legendary outlaw Robin Hood

explanation.surface: Where a small garden bird builds its home.
explanation.walkthrough: Robin Hood, the English outlaw of legend, hid with his band in this Nottinghamshire woodland.
explanation.definitionFit: The outlaw Robin Hood's home base in the legends was this woodland, his figurative nest.

clue.text: No longer has a reputation for striking

parts.note: out means no longer in place or in fashion
standing is one's reputation or status

explanation.surface: Someone who has lost their good name over going on strike.
explanation.walkthrough: 'striking' looks like taking industrial action; it means remarkable.
explanation.definitionFit: Something outstanding is notably excellent, as is something striking.

clue.text: Being capable of thoughtful communication

parts.note: thoughtful seems to mean considerate, but here it means passing messages by thought alone, mind to mind

explanation.surface: A description of someone who talks in a considerate, reflective way.
explanation.definitionFit: The word describes passing thoughts directly from one mind to another without speech.

clue.text: The bride will be up in arms over it

definitions.text: The bride will be up in arms over it

parts.words: The bride will be up in arms over it
parts.note: up in arms seems to mean angry, but here a groom carries the bride in his arms across the doorstep

explanation.surface: Something that will make a bride furious.
explanation.definitionFit: By tradition a bridegroom carries his bride over the doorway sill of their new home.

clue.text: Employer provides course in the City

indicators.note: one piece sits inside the other, the course placed in the city

parts.note: Ur is the ancient Mesopotamian city, a crossword favourite
SE, south-east, is a compass course to steer

explanation.surface: A company runs a training course in the City of London.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the City' suggests London's financial district, but it is Ur of the Chaldees.
explanation.definitionFit: One who employs something, in the sense of using it, is its user.

clue.text: Particularly the highest

definitions.meaning: literally over everything else in height

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means especially, and literally describes what is higher than everything.

clue.text: Gown worn by king receiving honour

indicators.note: the king gets the honour added to him, so it follows on after

parts.note: R is short for rex, Latin for king
the OBE, Order of the British Empire, is a British honour

explanation.surface: A monarch wears a ceremonial gown while being given an honour.
explanation.definitionFit: A robe is a long loose gown, often ceremonial.

clue.text: Fight with a bird that might be highly strung

parts.note: to box is to fight with fists
a kite is a bird of prey

explanation.surface: A nervous bird gets into a fight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'highly strung' suggests nervy, but a kite flies high on a string.
explanation.definitionFit: A box kite is a boxy kite flown high in the air on a string.

clue.text: Loaf around for a while?

parts.note: seems to be about idling, but a loaf that has been around for some time has gone off

explanation.surface: Someone asks if it is fine to laze about for a bit.
explanation.definitionFit: Bread left about for some time becomes old and dry, which is the cryptic loaf.

clue.text: Give a subject a title, perhaps

definitions.text: Give a subject a title, perhaps

parts.words: Give a subject a title, perhaps
parts.note: seems to be about heading an essay topic, but a royal subject is raised to the peerage

explanation.surface: Advice on naming the topic of an essay.
explanation.definitionFit: To raise a person to the nobility is to give them a title such as lord.

clue.text: Give rating a note to be taken between ships

indicators.note: the note goes in the middle, with ships on either side

parts.note: SS stands for steamship; the plural is used twice
SS stands for steamship; the plural is used twice
E is a musical note

explanation.surface: A sailor is given a message carried between vessels.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rating' looks like a naval sailor, but it is the noun of evaluation.
explanation.definitionFit: To assess something is to evaluate it, giving it a rating.

clue.text: Numbers out of order

definitions.meaning: the plural numerals six and seven are numbers
the idiom at ... means in confusion

explanation.definitionFit: Literally a pair of plural numerals; idiomatically, being in a state of confusion or disorder.

clue.text: A sign of increasing significance

parts.note: seems to mean a portent of growing importance, but is the mathematical symbol for adding

explanation.surface: An omen that something is becoming more important.
explanation.definitionFit: The cross-shaped symbol for addition, an advantage or positive, signals an increase.

clue.text: Dressing girl with something well turned out

parts.note: Olive is a girl's name
oil is what an oil well produces, turning it out

explanation.surface: A girl dresses herself in a smart outfit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'well turned out' reads as smartly dressed, but it is a well producing something.
explanation.definitionFit: Olive oil is a common salad dressing ingredient.

clue.text: Fish hook used by the Spanish

parts.note: a barb is a hook or the backward point on one
el is the Spanish definite article

explanation.surface: An angler's hook used by fishermen in Spain.
explanation.definitionFit: The barbel is a freshwater fish with whiskery barbels around its mouth.

clue.text: Don gets silver, note, in Olympic event

parts.note: to don is to put on clothes, to dress
Ag is the chemical symbol for silver
E is a musical note

explanation.surface: A university don wins a silver medal at the Olympics.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Don' looks like an academic, but it is the verb to put on.
explanation.definitionFit: Dressage, horse training displays, is an equestrian event at the Olympic Games.

clue.text: Trees entitled to respect

definitions.meaning: elder shrubs and small trees, with white flowers and dark berries
senior people whose age earns deference

explanation.definitionFit: Both a plural of a tree name and older people owed respect; a noun in each sense.
